scope: Registered official client-message conditions plus applicable shared globals; no log-only MY or other libraries CR codes. Warning/Note responses never automatically raise; mappings apply only to an actual protocol ERR.

client.name: NUMERIC_RANGE
client.meaning: an accurate numeric value exceeds the approved SQL policy.

client.name: SESSION_STATE
client.meaning: confirmed session state does not admit this operation.

client.name: RESOURCE_LIMIT
client.meaning: a configured native request or result limit was hit.

client.name: PROTOCOL
client.meaning: malformed or incomplete server protocol data.

client.name: UNSUPPORTED_CHARSET
client.meaning: a known charset cannot be used by this operation.

client.name: TEMPLATE_BINDING
client.meaning: an unsupported active SQL template directive.

client.name: PARAMETER_COUNT
client.meaning: current adapter width differs from SQL positions.

client.name: CONTAINER_NESTING
client.meaning: a true container cycle or excessive active nesting depth.

client.name: DECODE_CONTENT
client.meaning: a supported result field contains invalid or unrepresentable data.

client.name: INTERFACE_BUSY
client.meaning: another operation owns this connection or Cursor.

client.name: INTERNAL_STATE
client.meaning: a real native ownership/state invariant failed.

client.name: TRANSPORT
client.meaning: actual connection preparation or transport I/O failed.

client.name: AUTHENTICATION
client.meaning: native authentication could not complete safely.

client.name: UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY
client.meaning: an actual protocol capability is not implemented.

client.name: READ_DEADLINE
client.meaning: a read made no progress before its deadline.

client.name: WRITE_DEADLINE
client.meaning: a write made no progress before its deadline.
